intro.lead: Kokand Dry Fruits is the link between the generous gardens of the Fergana Valley and the global market for healthy food.
p1.d: High in vitamin A, vitamin C, iron and potassium, which support the heart and blood vessels. They also aid digestion.
p2.d: Grapes dried the natural way. Prized for their sweetness, their goodness and how well they keep.
p3.d: Sweet and full-flavoured, served with tea and used throughout cooking and confectionery. They keep for a long time.
p4.d: Walnuts carry protein, nourishing fatty acids, potassium, magnesium, iron and vitamin E. They support memory and help build immunity.
p5.d: Rich in protein, healthy fatty acids, potassium, magnesium and B vitamins. They give the body energy and strengthen the immune system.
p6.d: Rich in protein, fibre, iron, magnesium and B vitamins. They aid digestion, give energy and suit light, dietary cooking.
proc.s1d: Orchards of the Fergana Valley and agronomic care at every stage of growth.
proc.s2d: Natural drying in sun and shade — vitamins stay in, additives stay out.
proc.s3d: Calibration, cleaning and sorting, with quality control on every batch.
proc.s4d: Container logistics, export paperwork and shipment on schedule.
proc.title: From the orchard to the container
prod.t3: Strict sorting of every single piece
prod.text: We combine long-standing farming traditions with modern processing. Every batch is sorted and checked by hand — no artificial colourings, no preservatives.
